The image shown is about 1456 px wide, so I scale coordinates by 2479/1456 ≈ 1.703.

The main Felca advertisement spans roughly x 102–1252 and y 140–1865 in the displayed image. In original pixels that is about x 174–2132 and y 238–3176.

There is also a sliver of another page on the left edge, from x 0 to 55 and y 0 to 1880 in the displayed image, with fragments of other ads. It is cut off and unreadable, so I am leaving it out.
